7mtwqs.q: On motorways and extra-urban roads, dipped headlights must be on even during the day, or alternatively the daytime running lights.
7mtwqs.why: Outside built-up areas you must drive with dipped headlights (anabbaglianti) on even by day; certified daytime running lights are the only alternative.

1tos40l.q: Incorrectly aimed headlights can reduce the driver's visibility or dazzle other road users.
1tos40l.why: Badly aimed headlights light the road poorly for you or shine into other drivers' eyes, so their aim must be correct.

us54zr.q: Badly aimed dipped headlights can dazzle other road users.
us54zr.why: Even dipped headlights (anabbaglianti) can dazzle others when they are aimed too high, so correct aim matters.

10gft8c.q: Even with dipped headlights on, you risk dazzling others if the bulbs are fitted incorrectly or are not approved.
10gft8c.why: Wrongly fitted or non-approved bulbs (lampade non omologate) can dazzle other drivers even when the dipped beam is selected.

oz314z.q: On a motor vehicle it is not permitted to use non-approved bulbs.
oz314z.why: Only approved (omologate) bulbs may be fitted, because they guarantee proper light output without dazzling others.

dmf3on.q: On an extra-urban road on a sunny day, it is enough to switch on the position lights.
dmf3on.why: Outside towns you need dipped headlights or daytime running lights even in sunshine; position lights (luci di posizione) alone are never enough.

4knimy.q: On an extra-urban road, it is mandatory to keep the full beams on during daytime.
4knimy.why: By day you must use dipped headlights, not full beams (abbaglianti); full beams are only for dark roads when nobody would be dazzled.

wrxarz.q: The use of position lights is mandatory at night during a stop outside the carriageway.
wrxarz.why: A vehicle stopped off the carriageway (fuori della carreggiata) does not need any lights on, as it is not in the traffic lane.

8wx79s.q: Position lights may use bulbs of any colour.
8wx79s.why: Position lights must be white or yellow at the front and red at the rear; other colours are not allowed.

10nd1pe.q: While driving in built-up areas, dipped headlights must be on from half an hour after sunset to half an hour before sunrise.
10nd1pe.why: In urban areas dipped headlights are required during the night window: 30 minutes after sunset until 30 minutes before sunrise.

8aid3l.q: While driving, in poor visibility due to weather (snow, rain, fog), position lights and dipped headlights must both be on.
8aid3l.why: In snow, rain or fog that reduces visibility, you must switch on both position lights and dipped headlights.

14hle2c.q: While driving in fog with visibility below 50 metres, you must use the rear fog light if the vehicle has one.
14hle2c.why: When fog cuts visibility below 50 metres, switch on the rear fog light (luce posteriore per nebbia) if your vehicle has one.

14riq8g.q: At night, in built-up areas, a vehicle parked at the edge of the carriageway may be signalled with parking lights.
14riq8g.why: In a town at night, a vehicle parked at the roadside may be made visible with parking lights (luci di sosta).

of0q21.q: While driving, it is mandatory to keep the full beams on from sunset to sunrise.
of0q21.why: Full beams (abbaglianti) are never compulsory; use them only on unlit roads when nobody would be dazzled, otherwise dipped beams.

be8lx7.q: At night, when stopped off the carriageway, it is mandatory to keep the dipped headlights on.
be8lx7.why: A vehicle stopped off the carriageway (fuori dalla carreggiata) does not need to keep its dipped headlights on.

mukyws.q: If you leave the vehicle in an authorised car park, it is mandatory to keep the parking lights on the whole time.
mukyws.why: In an authorised car park (parcheggio autorizzato) you do not have to leave any lights on.

q7n364.q: It is mandatory to switch on the dipped headlights, even by day, when driving through a tunnel.
q7n364.why: In a tunnel (galleria) dipped headlights are always required, day or night.

1tj59vd.q: It is mandatory to switch on the vehicle's lights when visibility is poor because of the weather (fog, snow, rain).
1tj59vd.why: When weather such as fog, snow or rain reduces visibility, you must switch your lights on.

nndgqe.q: It is mandatory to switch on the dipped headlights in road tunnels only if they are poorly lit.
nndgqe.why: Dipped headlights are compulsory in every tunnel (galleria), whether lit or not, not just in dim ones.

1n3yhor.q: While driving in heavy rain, in addition to the dipped headlights you must keep the rear fog light on, if the vehicle has one.
1n3yhor.why: In heavy rain, use the rear fog light (luce posteriore per nebbia) as well as dipped headlights, if the vehicle has one.

vipix6.q: While driving outside built-up areas, it is mandatory to use dipped headlights, both by day and by night.
vipix6.why: Outside built-up areas dipped headlights (anabbaglianti) must be on at all times while moving, day and night.

1y7fv8i.q: While driving at night, using dipped headlights is mandatory even if public lighting is sufficient.
1y7fv8i.why: At night you must use dipped headlights while moving even on streets with good public lighting.

1jzwka4.q: While driving in heavy snowfall, in addition to the dipped headlights you must keep the rear fog light on, if the vehicle has one.
1jzwka4.why: In heavy snowfall, add the rear fog light (luce posteriore per nebbia) to your dipped headlights if you have one.

qbk1ut.q: While driving, the use of dipped headlights is not permitted in lit tunnels.
qbk1ut.why: Dipped headlights are compulsory in all tunnels, including well-lit ones, so they are certainly allowed.

1l9p9e1.q: While driving, the use of position lights is always permitted as an alternative to dipped headlights.
1l9p9e1.why: Position lights (luci di posizione) alone cannot replace dipped headlights when driving, for example outside towns or in poor visibility.

q2f6i0.q: Using dipped headlights is mandatory when overtaking a police car.
q2f6i0.why: There is no special lighting rule for overtaking a police car; normal rules on lights apply.

38nswd.q: Reflectors are devices that reflect light.
38nswd.why: Reflectors (catadiottri) are passive devices that bounce back the light from other vehicles' headlights.

bkzrqd.q: The reflectors fitted at the rear of vehicles are red.
bkzrqd.why: Rear reflectors (catadiottri) on vehicles are red.

607e84.q: The reflectors fitted at the rear of trailers and light trailers (carrelli-appendice) are red and triangular.
607e84.why: At the back of trailers and carrelli-appendice the reflectors are red and triangular.

j7mldj.q: Reflectors are also fitted on trailers and light trailers (carrelli-appendice).
j7mldj.why: Trailers and carrelli-appendice also carry reflectors (catadiottri).

aantrb.q: The reflectors fitted on the front of trailers and light trailers (carrelli-appendice) are white.
aantrb.why: Front reflectors on trailers and carrelli-appendice are white.

1vf0ebn.q: Reflectors are switched on half an hour after sunset.
1vf0ebn.why: Reflectors (catadiottri) are passive and cannot be switched on; they only reflect light that hits them.

1qpzui1.q: Reflectors are switched on together with the position lights.
1qpzui1.why: Reflectors (catadiottri) have no switch; they work only by reflecting other vehicles' light.

1n0pr7i.q: Reflectors replace position lights when driving on urban roads.
1n0pr7i.why: Reflectors (catadiottri) never replace position lights; the lights are still required when the rules call for them.

hltuq8.q: Reflectors have the function of showing the presence and the size of the vehicles they are fitted to.
hltuq8.why: Reflectors (catadiottri) mark the presence and width of the vehicle they are fitted to.

6s37k9.q: White reflectors have the function of highlighting the front of trailers and semi-trailers.
6s37k9.why: White reflectors (catadiottri) make the front of trailers and semi-trailers visible.

15kaima.q: Reflectors, when illuminated, have the function of making vehicles and trailers parked on the road more visible, especially at night.
15kaima.why: When lit by other vehicles' headlights, reflectors (catadiottri) make parked vehicles and trailers easier to see at night.

1y1wgy2.q: Reflectors make a broken-down vehicle more visible if the rear position lights do not work.
1y1wgy2.why: If the rear position lights fail, the reflectors (catadiottri) still make a broken-down vehicle visible.

j60g8c.q: Reflectors, together with the direction indicators, signal that a vehicle is turning.
j60g8c.why: Reflectors (catadiottri) do not signal turns; only direction indicators (indicatori di direzione) do.

15wbfxm.q: White reflectors are fitted on motor vehicles carrying flammable material.
15wbfxm.why: White reflectors (catadiottri) mark the front of trailers and semi-trailers, not the carriage of flammable goods.

1pa5van.q: Reflectors can replace the direction indicators.
1pa5van.why: Reflectors (catadiottri) are passive and cannot replace direction indicators, which emit flashing light.

13xnbk5.q: The rear number plate of a motor vehicle is illuminated so that its characters can be read easily.
13xnbk5.why: The number plate light lets the rear plate's characters be read easily.

vd5z5m.q: The rear number plate of a motor vehicle must be lit with white light.
vd5z5m.why: The rear number plate (targa) must be lit with white light.

gmu8el.q: The number plate light of a motor vehicle must be switched on only at night.
gmu8el.why: The plate light comes on with the position lights, so it is also on by day whenever those lights are in use, such as in poor visibility.

1czca30.q: The number plate light of a motor vehicle must stay on if you stop off the road.
1czca30.why: A vehicle stopped off the road needs no lights, so the plate light need not stay on.

125id7o.q: The warning light showing that the hazard warning lights are on is red.
125id7o.why: The hazard warning light indicator on the dashboard is red.

1ovlbw5.q: The coolant temperature warning light is red.
1ovlbw5.why: The coolant temperature warning light is red, signalling overheating.

mvzcyu.q: The oil pressure warning light is red.
mvzcyu.why: The oil pressure warning light is red; it means dangerously low pressure and you should stop the engine.

xix1b4.q: The seatbelt warning light is red.
xix1b4.why: The seatbelt warning light on the dashboard is red.

14dl7j2.q: The handbrake warning light is red.
14dl7j2.why: The handbrake warning light is red.

rusnwb.q: The warning light showing that the direction indicators are on is red.
rusnwb.why: The direction indicator light on the dashboard is green and flashing, not red.

18sq85c.q: The warning light showing that the dipped headlights are on is red.
18sq85c.why: The dipped headlight indicator is green, not red.

r3pbrt.q: The warning light showing that the full beams are on is red.
r3pbrt.why: The full beam indicator is blue, not red.

pcy835.q: The fog light warning light is red.
pcy835.why: The front fog light indicator is green and the rear one is amber, not red.

1cpmtqy.q: The warning light of the demister or defrosting device for the windscreen is red.
1cpmtqy.why: The windscreen demister indicator is not red; red is kept for faults and safety warnings.

1igi8x6.q: The symbol shown is placed on the control that switches on the full beam headlights.
1igi8x6.why: The symbol with horizontal rays means full beam (proiettori di profondità, abbaglianti) and appears on its control.

1azwyil.q: The symbol shown is placed on a blue warning light.
1azwyil.why: The full beam symbol appears on a blue warning light.

7185ny.q: The symbol shown is placed on a green warning light.
7185ny.why: The full beam symbol is on a blue warning light, not a green one.

xfyv8v.q: The symbol shown is placed on the control that switches on the dipped headlights.
xfyv8v.why: The symbol shown has horizontal rays and means full beam; dipped headlights use rays angled downwards.

nraofb.q: The symbol shown indicates that the rear fog light is on.
nraofb.why: The symbol shown means full beam on; the rear fog light has a different symbol.

1fpwdi3.q: The symbol shown reminds the driver to switch off the position lights.
1fpwdi3.why: The symbol shown indicates full beam on and has nothing to do with position lights.

2wvo8e.q: The symbol shown is placed on the control that switches on the dipped headlights.
2wvo8e.why: The symbol with rays angled downwards means dipped headlights (anabbaglianti) and appears on their control.

h8mk4v.q: The symbol shown is placed on a green warning light.
h8mk4v.why: The dipped headlight symbol appears on a green warning light.

1umjzco.q: The symbol shown is placed on a blue warning light.
1umjzco.why: Blue is for full beam; the symbol shown, with rays angled down, is for dipped headlights and sits on a green light.

lugzj0.q: The symbol shown indicates that the rear fog light is on.
lugzj0.why: The symbol shown means dipped headlights, not the rear fog light.

135ln8l.q: The symbol shown is placed on the warning light for full beams on.
135ln8l.why: The symbol shown, with downward-angled rays, is for dipped headlights; full beam has horizontal rays.

11xig8d.q: The symbol shown indicates that the position lights are on.
11xig8d.why: The symbol shown means dipped headlights; position lights have their own separate symbol.

1fnm55l.q: The symbol shown indicates the control to operate the right direction indicator.
1fnm55l.why: The symbol shown is for dipped headlights; direction indicators are shown with arrows.

fp0ci7.q: The symbol shown indicates the control of the direction indicators.
fp0ci7.why: The pair of opposite arrows stands for the direction indicator control (indicatori di direzione).

21ruic.q: The symbol shown is placed on a green warning light.
21ruic.why: The arrow symbol appears on a green warning light.

1ploc41.q: The symbol shown is found on the flashing green warning light of the direction indicator in use.
1ploc41.why: The arrows are shown on the flashing green light of the direction indicator you have switched on.

1gtoi5x.q: The symbol shown is placed on a red warning light.
1gtoi5x.why: The direction indicator warning light is green, not red.

ut6gho.q: The symbol shown is found on a warning light that comes on when the position lights are on.
ut6gho.why: The arrows relate to the direction indicators, not to position lights, which have their own indicator.

1egnvf6.q: The symbol shown indicates the control to switch on the position lights.
1egnvf6.why: The symbol shown is for direction indicators, not position lights.

1u3nqf8.q: The symbol shown indicates the control to activate the hazard warning lights.
1u3nqf8.why: The triangle inside a triangle is the symbol for the hazard warning light control (segnalazione luminosa di pericolo).

1oc3our.q: The symbol shown is placed on the control that switches on all the direction indicators at the same time.
1oc3our.why: This control makes all the direction indicators flash together, which are the hazard lights.

154tlgm.q: The symbol shown is placed on a red warning light.
154tlgm.why: The hazard light indicator on the dashboard is red.

b1tae6.q: The symbol shown indicates a device to be used in emergencies.
b1tae6.why: The hazard lights are for emergencies, such as a stopped or broken-down vehicle.

lxgz4j.q: The symbol shown indicates the control that operates the mobile danger signal.
lxgz4j.why: The symbol shown is the hazard light control; the mobile danger signal is the warning triangle you place on the road.

1silmc8.q: The symbol shown is placed on the warning light for the handbrake engaged.
1silmc8.why: The handbrake light uses a different symbol; this one is for the hazard lights.

fo6v74.q: The symbol shown indicates a device that switches on automatically at every accident.
fo6v74.why: The hazard lights are switched on with a control by the driver, not automatically at every accident.

1pbc1ei.q: Direction indicators must be used before every lane change when driving on a road divided into lanes.
1pbc1ei.why: On a multi-lane road, signal with the direction indicators (indicatori di direzione) before every lane change.

41x0xg.q: Direction indicators must be used if, driving on a one-way street, you move to the left lane from the right one.
41x0xg.why: Even on a one-way street you must signal when moving from the right lane to the left lane.

1bltsx9.q: Direction indicators must be used every time you make a turning manoeuvre.
1bltsx9.why: Always signal with the direction indicators before any turn.

8jy16z.q: Direction indicators must be used if you intend to leave the carriageway to make a stop.
8jy16z.why: Signal with the direction indicators before leaving the carriageway to stop.

4m349d.q: Direction indicators must be used when, starting from the edge of the carriageway, you want to enter traffic.
4m349d.why: When pulling away from the roadside into the traffic flow, signal first with the direction indicators.

1v333lk.q: Direction indicators must be used to signal the intention to move into the deceleration lane of a motorway junction.
1v333lk.why: Signal with the indicators when moving into the deceleration lane (corsia di decelerazione) of a motorway exit.

1x9v6fw.q: Direction indicators must be used to signal the intention to enter the motorway carriageway coming from an acceleration lane.
1x9v6fw.why: When merging from the acceleration lane (corsia di accelerazione) onto the motorway, signal with the indicators.
